lines.say: a mix of small peptides and amino acids taken from pig brain
better thinking scores in vascular dementia (6 small trials, very low certainty)
no fewer deaths after stroke across 7 pooled trials (1,773 people)
kidney function checked first; severe kidney impairment rules it out
ruled out in epilepsy, in the maker's prescribing information
about 2.4 times the risk of non-fatal serious side effects in stroke trials

ask: Given that stroke trials found more serious side effects, is any benefit worth the risk for me?
